ghoulkin.name: Ghoulkin
ghoulkin.memory_rule: It follows erased names and abandons food when a token is nearby.
ghoulkin.motivation: A denied name is the only thing holding its borrowed body together.

bog_wretch.name: Bog Wretch
bog_wretch.memory_rule: It hides beside memory-rich roots and retreats when ash exposes its core.
bog_wretch.motivation: It protects the last frightened memory absorbed by the marsh.

gravebound_knight.name: Gravebound Knight
gravebound_knight.memory_rule: It guards a sealed threshold and tests every oath spoken near it.
gravebound_knight.motivation: It believes keeping the order is the only way to keep the dead contained.

wychwood_stalker.name: Wychwood Stalker
wychwood_stalker.memory_rule: It circles behind the witness and remembers where the trap was placed.
wychwood_stalker.motivation: It hunts the hands that moved the evidence after the road attack.

wychwood_raider.name: Wychwood Raider
wychwood_raider.memory_rule: It feints toward the body, then lunges for carried tokens and loose evidence.
wychwood_raider.motivation: It is pulled toward the objects that still carry a living person's name.

wychwood_brute.name: Wychwood Brute
wychwood_brute.memory_rule: It arrives last and breaks the route rather than pursuing beyond its clearing.
wychwood_brute.motivation: It carries the weight of many bodies but only one unfinished command.

white_hart_avatar.name: White Hart Avatar
white_hart_avatar.memory_rule: It answers names with memory echoes and cannot be forced to accept a false oath.
white_hart_avatar.motivation: It is the witness bound beneath the road, not a benevolent forest god.

bell_eater.name: The Bell-Eater
bell_eater.memory_rule: Its bell shockwave grows from the graves; silence interrupts its summons.
bell_eater.motivation: It consumes the names Greyfen buried because the bell is the only witness left.

rootbound_colossus.name: Rootbound Colossus
rootbound_colossus.memory_rule: Its root lanes leave a readable central gap and its heart opens after a rupture.
rootbound_colossus.motivation: It defends the soil fed by the ash of people Greyfen refused to name.

ashwing.name: Ashwing Carrion Drake
ashwing.memory_rule: Its breath and wing pressure are directional; breaking its perch exposes it.
ashwing.motivation: It nests above the mill where refugee ash became part of the harvest.

halvern_boss.name: Halvern, Gravebound Knight
halvern_boss.memory_rule: Its guard can be broken by a clean parry, opening a testimony window.
halvern_boss.motivation: It stayed loyal until obedience became murder, then chose the grave as punishment.
